title: balsamorhiza × terebinthacea
intro: Balsamorhiza × terebinthacea, commonly known as Terebinth Root or Balsamroot, is a hybrid plant that is a cross between the Great Balsamroot (Balsamorhiza macrophylla) and the Rocky Mountain Balsamroot (Balsamorhiza deltoidea). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, providing health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Terebinth Root include calming the nervous system, reducing fever, and acting as a natural remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Balsamorhiza × terebinthacea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
